SURVIVAL CONTROLS / G grenade · X electric trap · F flashlight · H bandage · Space jump · sprint + crouch slide. TRANSIT SURVIVAL / Earn TRACE, buy district access, then walk through fog or call a 250-TRACE transit pod. Collect three parts and hold E at a matching workbench. Central Stacks holds main power. A turbine placed there opens the North Skyway vault to gunfire; upgrade inside. Banked TRACE persists on this browser/origin only. Body carry preserves the original progression, not the current wave, perks, equipment or district purchases; health is carried as a percentage. Clearing browser data removes the bank.

The route follows the supplied city scene’s broken street plates and short bridge links from the south block to the far urban cluster. The physical C-17 alien PC is installed beside the connected street route: seat its fuse, bridge the contact, stay nearby while the carrier stabilizes, then face and touch the screen with E. Channel access has no menu, death-screen, or keyboard-only route. West and east tower streets loop back into the boulevard; S-04 and S-11 persist on the route. Tap Fire to use the equipped sidearm. After buying the GBE for 3500 TRACE, hold and release Fire to charge it. Q cycles owned weapons. Light and footsteps betray you. City defense waves spawn at the street perimeter; survive each wave for a nine-second regroup. TRACE rewards hits and kills. S-04 and S-11 remain independent, persistent route encounters. Defense waves and TRACE restart when a Body record is loaded; the original save format is unchanged.

Session-only flight. Space up · crouch down. Not invulnerability.

Recording settings

Field equipment.

Session-only flight. Space up · crouch down. Not invulnerability.

Compare the same place in Clear, Recorded and Bodycam. Bodycam adds restrained lens curvature, slight peripheral chromatic separation, monochrome film grain and an edge vignette, without block compression. Strength is tunable; 0 removes optical/sensor character. Camera weight is separate: 0 removes sway and bob. SSAO contact shading runs before the first-person weapon. Depth-aware GBE shafts build during charge and burst on discharge; set Volumetric light to Off to disable them. Red damage edges decay rapidly, with a persistent low-health warning. The GBE charges while Fire is held and discharges on release; set the mix with Audio level. Esc opens the field controls. The Channel is available only at the physical C-17 alien terminal. This single-file client uses original procedural geometry, embedded surface maps and locally synthesized sound; it requests no external assets.
